verdict.rationale: Logseq's local HTTP API server serves its own API documentation at http://127.0.0.1:12315/ and documents a single POST /api dispatch endpoint with worked curl examples, whose methods map to the plugin API reference at plugins-doc.logseq.com. Nothing shows that this reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or sandbox. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it explorer, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, a first-party (not community-driven) method reference, an executable example sandbox, and hands-on corroboration.
